$comment: DTM 2006 over the era base (bases/dtm-era3). New cars weighed 1,050 kg, 2005 cars 1,035 kg (the 2004 cars' weight is not known): the lowest chassis figure is 890 kg once the engine is taken off. Knockout qualifying in three parts as in the base; the real one dropped the slowest six per part (wishlist A6). The manufacturer success ballast of plus or minus 10 kg is not modelled (wishlist B1, B2).

add_options.name: DTM 2006
add_options.summary: 1,050 kg for new cars, 1,035 kg for older cars, including the driver.
add_options.description: Older cars ran 15 kg lighter. The chassis figure here excludes the engine mass the game adds on top.
